title: Newmark Arranges $45.9 Million in FHA Financing for Two Class A Multifamily Communities in Grand Junction, Colorado
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged approximately $45.9 million in FHA-insured financing for two recently developed Class A multifamily communities in Grand Junction, Colorado.
body_markdown: Newmark announces the Company has arranged approximately $45.9 million in FHA-insured financing for two recently developed Class A multifamily communities in Grand Junction, Colorado.
